<!-- Partial: linking topics to psychographic traits. -->

This section operationalizes the outline task **Linking Topics to Psychological Traits**.
We connect discovered topics/narratives to psychographic signals by:

- identifying agents heavily involved in each topic,
- averaging their trait/value profiles,
- estimating topic-to-trait relationships (including significance),
- surfacing archetypal examples.

```{python}
#| label: topics-psych-load
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from utils import ROOT

# Topic dataframe from previous section (preferred) or fallback from persisted posts.
if "_posts" in globals():
    topic_df = _posts.copy()
else:
    topic_df = pd.read_parquet(ROOT / "data" / "posts-norm.parquet")

if "bertopic_id" in topic_df.columns:
    topic_key = "bertopic_id"
elif "topic_id" in topic_df.columns:
    topic_key = "topic_id"
else:
    raise RuntimeError("No topic column found (`bertopic_id` or `topic_id`).")

psych_path = ROOT / "data" / "posts-psychographic.parquet"
if not psych_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing {psych_path}. Run psychographic profiling first.")
psych_df = pd.read_parquet(psych_path)

if "agent" not in topic_df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected `agent` in topic dataframe.")
if "agent" not in psych_df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected `agent` in posts-psychographic dataframe.")

# Join by post id when available; fallback to positional join after truncation.
if "post_id" in topic_df.columns and "post_id" in psych_df.columns:
    link_df = topic_df[["post_id", "agent", "submolt", topic_key]].merge(
        psych_df, on=["post_id", "agent", "submolt"], how="inner"
    )
elif "_orig_index" in topic_df.columns and "post_id" in psych_df.columns:
    link_df = topic_df[["_orig_index", "agent", "submolt", topic_key]].merge(
        psych_df,
        left_on=["_orig_index", "agent", "submolt"],
        right_on=["post_id", "agent", "submolt"],
        how="inner",
    )
else:
    n = min(len(topic_df), len(psych_df))
    tmp_t = topic_df.iloc[:n].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    tmp_p = psych_df.iloc[:n].copy().reset_index(drop=True)
    link_df = pd.concat([tmp_t[[topic_key, "agent", "submolt"]], tmp_p], axis=1)

score_cols = [
    c
    for c in link_df.columns
    if c.startswith("emotion_") or c.startswith("ocean_") or c.startswith("value_")
]
if not score_cols:
    raise RuntimeError("No psychographic score columns found in merged dataset.")

print(f"Link rows: {len(link_df):,} | topic_key={topic_key!r} | score_dims={len(score_cols)}")
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-psych-agent-participation
#| message: false
#| warning: false

TOPIC_MIN_POSTS = 25
AGENT_HEAVY_SHARE = 0.20

topic_posts = link_df[link_df[topic_key] != -1].copy()
topic_sizes = topic_posts[topic_key].value_counts()
valid_topics = topic_sizes[topic_sizes >= TOPIC_MIN_POSTS].index
topic_posts = topic_posts[topic_posts[topic_key].isin(valid_topics)].copy()

agent_topic_counts = (
    topic_posts.groupby(["agent", topic_key], observed=True)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="posts_in_topic")
)
agent_total_counts = (
    topic_posts.groupby("agent", observed=True)
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="posts_total")
)

agent_topic_participation = agent_topic_counts.merge(agent_total_counts, on="agent", how="left")
agent_topic_participation["share_in_topic"] = (
    agent_topic_participation["posts_in_topic"] / agent_topic_participation["posts_total"]
)

heavy_agents = agent_topic_participation[
    agent_topic_participation["share_in_topic"] >= AGENT_HEAVY_SHARE
].copy()

print("Heavy-involvement agent-topic pairs (top 20):")
print(
    heavy_agents.sort_values("share_in_topic", ascending=False)
    .head(20)
    .to_string(index=False)
)
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-psych-topic-profiles
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Topic -> psychographic profile: mean of heavy-involvement agents.
if heavy_agents.empty:
    topic_psych_profile_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=[topic_key, "n_heavy_agents", "n_posts"] + score_cols)
    print("No heavy-involvement agent-topic pairs after filtering; topic profiles are empty.")
else:
    topic_profile_rows = []
    for tid, grp in heavy_agents.groupby(topic_key, observed=True):
        agents_for_topic = grp["agent"].unique()
        sub = link_df[link_df["agent"].isin(agents_for_topic)].copy()
        row = {
            topic_key: int(tid),
            "n_heavy_agents": int(len(agents_for_topic)),
            "n_posts": int((topic_posts[topic_key] == tid).sum()),
        }
        for c in score_cols:
            row[c] = float(sub[c].mean())
        topic_profile_rows.append(row)

    topic_psych_profile_df = (
        pd.DataFrame(topic_profile_rows)
        .sort_values("n_posts", ascending=False)
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )

    print("Topic -> psychographic mean profiles (head):")
    show_cols = [topic_key, "n_posts", "n_heavy_agents"] + score_cols[:8]
    print(topic_psych_profile_df[show_cols].head(12).to_string(index=False))
```

#| label: topics-psych-archetypes
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Archetypal narrative examples: top posts for selected dimensions.
anchor_dims = [d for d in ["value_benevolence", "ocean_openness", "ocean_neuroticism"] if d in score_cols]
if not anchor_dims:
    anchor_dims = score_cols[:3]

archetype_rows = []
for dim in anchor_dims:
    top_rows = link_df.nlargest(3, dim)
    for _, r in top_rows.iterrows():
        archetype_rows.append(
            {
                "dimension": dim,
                topic_key: int(r[topic_key]) if pd.notna(r[topic_key]) else -1,
                "agent": r["agent"],
                "submolt": r.get("submolt", "(missing)"),
                "score": float(r[dim]),
                "text_excerpt": str(r.get("text", ""))[:180].replace("\n", " "),
            }
        )

topic_archetypes_df = pd.DataFrame(archetype_rows)
print("Archetypal narrative examples:")
print(topic_archetypes_df.to_string(index=False))

```{python}
#| label: topics-psych-significance
#| message: false
#| warning: false

from scipy.stats import kruskal

def _bh_adjust(pvals: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    p = pvals.astype(float).values
    n = len(p)
    order = np.argsort(p)
    ranked = np.empty(n, dtype=float)
    prev = 1.0
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        idx = order[i]
        rank = i + 1
        val = min(prev, p[idx] * n / rank)
        ranked[idx] = val
        prev = val
    return pd.Series(ranked, index=pvals.index)


sig_rows = []
if topic_posts.empty:
    topic_significance_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["dimension", "n_topics", "kruskal_H", "p_value", "q_value"])
    print("No topic-post rows available for significance tests.")
else:
    topic_levels = sorted(topic_posts[topic_key].unique())
    for dim in score_cols:
        groups = [
            topic_posts.loc[topic_posts[topic_key] == t, dim].dropna().values
            for t in topic_levels
        ]
        groups = [g for g in groups if len(g) >= 5]
        if len(groups) < 2:
            continue
        H, p = kruskal(*groups)
        sig_rows.append(
            {
                "dimension": dim,
                "n_topics": len(groups),
                "kruskal_H": float(H),
                "p_value": float(p),
            }
        )

    topic_significance_df = pd.DataFrame(sig_rows)
    if not topic_significance_df.empty:
        topic_significance_df["q_value"] = _bh_adjust(topic_significance_df["p_value"])
        topic_significance_df = topic_significance_df.sort_values(["q_value", "p_value"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        print("Topic-wise trait significance (Kruskal-Wallis + BH correction):")
        print(topic_significance_df.head(20).to_string(index=False))
    else:
        print("No valid dimensions for significance testing.")
```

```{python}
#| label: topics-psych-ranked-statements
#| message: false
#| warning: false

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

def _bootstrap_ci(vals: np.ndarray, n_boot: int = 400, alpha: float = 0.05) -> tuple[float, float]:
    vals = np.asarray(vals, dtype=float)
    if len(vals) == 0:
        return (float("nan"), float("nan"))
    if len(vals) == 1:
        v = float(vals[0])
        return (v, v)
    boots = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        s = rng.choice(vals, size=len(vals), replace=True)
        boots.append(np.mean(s))
    lo = float(np.quantile(boots, alpha / 2))
    hi = float(np.quantile(boots, 1 - alpha / 2))
    return (lo, hi)


rank_rows = []
if not topic_posts.empty:
    global_means = topic_posts[score_cols].mean()

    # Focus on dimensions that show strongest across-topic signal.
    if not topic_significance_df.empty:
        focus_dims = topic_significance_df["dimension"].head(10).tolist()
    else:
        focus_dims = (
            topic_posts[score_cols]
            .var(axis=0)
            .sort_values(ascending=False)
            .head(10)
            .index
            .tolist()
        )

    for tid, grp in topic_posts.groupby(topic_key, observed=True):
        for dim in focus_dims:
            vals = grp[dim].dropna().values
            if len(vals) < 8:
                continue
            m = float(np.mean(vals))
            lo, hi = _bootstrap_ci(vals)
            delta = m - float(global_means[dim])
            rank_rows.append(
                {
                    topic_key: int(tid),
                    "topic_label": _label_map.get(int(tid), f"Topic {int(tid)}"),
                    "dimension": dim,
                    "n_posts_topic": int(len(grp)),
                    "mean_score": m,
                    "delta_vs_corpus": delta,
                    "ci_low": lo,
                    "ci_high": hi,
                }
            )

topic_trait_ranked_df = pd.DataFrame(rank_rows)
if not topic_trait_ranked_df.empty:
    topic_trait_ranked_df = topic_trait_ranked_df.sort_values(
        "delta_vs_corpus", ascending=False
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    print("Ranked topic-trait statements (highest deltas first):")
    print(topic_trait_ranked_df.head(25).to_string(index=False))
else:
    print("No ranked statements generated (insufficient data after filters).")
```
